From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: missed: Intro call — Redwood Inference / Acme Pay (9:30am PT)

Thanks, Oliver — totally understand and hope the incident is resolved.

I’ve attached the short demo and a one-page starter doc on our data-handling model for test environments (see "acme-initial-proposal.pdf"). Quick answers here so your security lead has context immediately:
- Data residency: customer-controlled VPC options + region pinning for Hosted/Private.
- Logging: request-level audit logs can be routed to your SIEM via S3/CloudWatch delivery; retention and anonymization are configurable per environment.
- Test env policy: KV cache persists only for session lifetime unless you opt-in to longer-term traces; we offer redaction hooks to remove PII automatically.

If you’d like, Ben (copied) is our AE and can join the 15-minute follow-up to talk pricing and minimal POC commitments. Pick a slot here and I’ll have Ben and a solutions engineer stand by: https://calendly.com/jasmine-liu/15min

Best,
Jasmine

--

Oliver — thanks for taking a look at the demo. Quick note from my side on next steps so we’re efficient next week:

1) If your security lead wants, we can run a 30-minute security/arch dive with our security engineer (we’ll keep it scoped to logging, residency, and network controls).
2) For the POC we typically start with a small snapshot: 1-2 models, 1 test dataset, 2-4 endpoints — that gives predictable cost and latency numbers for your use case.

If you share 2-3 availability windows (or pick from Jasmine’s Calendly), I’ll schedule the 15-minute discovery and include the SE/security engineer as requested.

Appreciate the ping — we’ll make the next call useful and tightly scoped.

—Ben
